scope: Independent review of the APP015 custody/acceptance instrument and isolated synthetic negative controls. This does not run application acceptance, seal status, execute Cubase, or establish runtime compatibility.

adaptation_review.gui_package_cardinality: Configuration-provided package and file counts, checked by the acceptance path; current GUI acceptance is independent of these instrument controls.

fixed_findings.issue: A valid hash-only pinned record reached the historical size-required matcher and raised KeyError instead of verifying its digest.
fixed_findings.correction: A single strict identity matcher requires a valid SHA-256 and verifies bytes when present; symlink targets use their distinct exact identity. The imported matcher is replaced only in memory; historical source is unchanged.

fixed_findings.issue: A digestless recursive manifest row could pass because the earlier matcher compared only keys present in the expected record.
fixed_findings.correction: Regular-file SHA-256 is mandatory and syntactically validated. Optional sizes must be nonnegative integers. Digestless, size-only and malformed digest records reject.

fixed_findings.issue: Recursive custody traversal did not verify external_references of every visited historical/native manifest.
fixed_findings.correction: Every visited manifest now verifies its external references, retaining the existing explicit preserved-byte substitution rule.

fixed_findings.issue: Review pin recognition needed to cover source_and_evidence and research evidence, and control records were captured after earlier acceptance publication.
fixed_findings.correction: All six supported review pin keys verify source and evidence identities. Review, control and finding records are captured before the first acceptance output is written.

coverage: Exact source inventory additions, removals, byte changes and symlink identity
Hash-only nested records and optional size; wrong hashes and changed sources
All six supported review pin keys, including source_and_evidence, with source and research-evidence changes
Recursive native manifest identity, duplicate paths and declared row count
Transitive hash-only external references and changed external bytes
Explicit preserved same-byte substitution and tampered preservation/linkage records
controls.failure_assertion: Negative controls require AssertionError; incidental KeyError is not accepted as a valid rejection.

real_readonly_preflight.result: All configured APP014 and APP015 native roots and their recursively referenced custody manifests verified.

retained_history.policy: Earlier unsealed reports remain as historical evidence of the intermediate revision; final controls and final preflight pin the current sealer.

limits: These tests validate the custody instrument, not the truth or completeness of a research claim.
The acceptance configuration and final GUI/app evidence must still be checked by the parent acceptance run.
No Application source, proprietary input, prior sealed study, or historical package was changed by this audit.
No Cubase runtime or exported-audio comparison was performed.
